forecast.generalSituationZh: 一股清勁至強風程度的東北季候風會在明日影響廣東沿岸。預料一道冷鋒會在星期一初時橫過華南沿岸，受隨後的強烈東北季候風影響，該區北風增強，氣溫顯著下降，下週中期廣東普遍晴朗及非常乾燥，早上清涼，日夜溫差較大。預料高空擾動會在下週後期為華南帶來驟雨。
forecast.generalSituationEn: A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China at first on Monday. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. The weather will be generally fine and very dry over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers to southern China in the latter part of next week.
